name: Sadducees The
overview: The Sadducees were a Jewish sect known for denying the resurrection and any future state, as highlighted by their direct challenge to Jesus on this doctrine (Matthew 22:23). They often opposed Christ and His followers, being cautioned against by Jesus for their corrupt teachings, referred to as 'leaven' (Matthew 16:6, 16:11-12). Their opposition is further seen in their attempts to tempt Jesus and their rejection of baptism by John (Matthew 3:7, 16:1). This group also actively persecuted early Christians and was ultimately silenced in the face of the gospel's truth.
